Write a single-feature MGF block (concat-friendly)

Source: R/export.R
write_simple_mgf.Rd

Writes one BEGIN IONS ... END IONS block (TITLE, PEPMASS, optional RTINSECONDS, CHARGE=1+, peaks). Used by clean_pseudo_spectra() when mgf_dir is set. Files can be joined with cat.

Usage

write_simple_mgf(pseudo_spec, mz_target, feature_id, path, rt = NA_real_)

Arguments

pseudo_spec

Filtered per-group table with fragment_mz and int.

mz_target

Numeric. Precursor m/z.

feature_id

Used as TITLE=.

path

Output .mgf path.

rt

Optional retention time (seconds); skipped when NA.

Value

Invisibly path, or NULL when pseudo_spec is empty.
